name: Video Interlude
description: Full-screen video playback page. Navigates to the next route when the video ends or when the user taps skip.
notes: Video src is read from CAPE: general.video.introVideo.

intro-video / loading-video / ad-video routes are now owned by the block-driven page builders (cli/page-builder.js, cli/tanstack-block-page-builder.js) — they are generated from blocks, not copied here. This module only provides the generic /video route plus shared infra (VideoLoader, VideoIntro).
loading-video is content-driven: it boots Unity via fullBoot() and advances the instant the engine is ready (no hard timer); a manual Continue button appears only if boot fails.
